messages:
lara: quick design pass on the in-product docs panel on Routes. spotted a few consistency + accessibility bits around code samples and deeplinks that I think are worth fixing before the next deploy.
mike: can you list the top issues so eng/docs can estimate?
lara: 1) code sample param mismatch: the inline examples show param name `model_flavour` (legacy) while the console selector and API use `model_variant` and the SDK examples use `modelVariant`. this confuses users copying examples into code. proposal: canonicalize on `model_variant` in docs and UI, and include a tiny "param mapping" note in the panel for SDK users (python/js).
toni: +1. also we should avoid snake/camel mix in docs samples. pick one variant per language tab (snake for python, camel for js) and show a mapping header.
lara: 2) language-specific anchors: examples are tabbed (Python / JS / Curl) but the panel "Examples" chevron opens the page top. users expect the chevron to open the exact language tab and example block (e.g., /routes#examples-python). request: add per-language anchors and have the chevron deep-link to the current language tab when possible.
docs-bot: docs-bot: opened PR #912 adding anchors examples-python and examples-js and replacing `model_flavour` with `model_variant` in examples. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/pulls/912 :white_check_mark:
a11y: accessibility notes: the chevron/target icon must be keyboard-focusable and have an aria-label like "Open docs: Python example". when the doc opens at an anchor, include a visually-hidden summary at the anchored heading describing the example context. also ensure focus moves to the doc's main heading after navigation and use aria-live to announce "Opened docs: Python example".
mike: keyboard focus: when the panel opens, we currently don't consistently move focus to the panel heading on Safari. ESC closing is flaky in Firefox. add focus trap + return focus on close and consistent key handlers.
toni: CTA language: the panel currently shows a generic "Read more" link and a secondary "Documentation" button. change to action-first, context-aware CTAs: inline -> "See Python example", primary -> "Open docs", and add an optional tertiary "Open in Playground" for examples that can be sandboxed. on mobile collapse extra actions into an overflow menu.
lara: "Open in Playground" is great for adoption, but it needs to be accessible: aria-label should read "Open in Playground: Python example" and it should prefill the example params. ensure any new button triggers a small toast "Opened playground" and is keyboard reachable.
a11y: when adding "Open in Playground" ensure the sandbox iframe has title and that the invoked sandbox receives focus in a way that doesn't trap keyboard users permanently. provide a visible close control with aria-label.
mike: dev note: we should detect whether a language anchor exists; fall back to doc root. keep deep links resilient if anchors change (add redirect aliases in docs).
toni: tiny UX ask: at the bottom of the panel add a one-line mini-glossary for param names (3 items) and a link "See full mapping" that opens the mapping file in docs. keep it collapsed by default on mobile.
docs-bot: docs-bot: opened issue RED-UI-1013 to add language anchors, the param mapping file, and Playground hooks. https://git.internal/r/redwood/docs/issues/1013
lara: timeline: toni to post a 1-page spec with exact aria labels + anchor list by EOD tomorrow; a11y will run a short checklist after PR merge; mike will slot the engineering work in the sprint.
a11y: will test keyboard + screen reader flows (NVDA/VO) once PR is up.
lara: thanks all 44d ping here when PR #912 or RED-UI-1013 have updates.
thread_summary: Design review about docs panel code-sample mismatches and deeplinks: canonicalize `model_variant` param, add per-language example anchors so chevrons open the correct tab, add param-mapping note and optional 'Open in Playground' CTA, ensure chevron is keyboard-focusable with aria-label and SR summary, enforce focus trap + ESC behavior across browsers, add collapsed mini-glossary and mobile overflow, and docs-bot linked PR/issue.
